digest: TimelineView tithi/nakshatra bands were capped at a fixed maxIterations=500, silently truncating rendering beyond ~1.4 years of zoom. Scaled the cap to the zoom range (1.5x margin, 2000 ceiling to bound ephemeris compute time). Regression test tests/test_timeline_max_iterations.py.
